steps.cap: The Allied player uses two engineers to blow four bridges. The 35th Engineer Battalion in Ligneuville [25] blows those to St. Vith [23] and Malmedy [33]; the 168th in Vielsalm [24] blows those to Malmedy [33] and Baraque de Fraiture [35].
An infantry and an armor unit in Prüm [4] both try to move to St. Vith [23].
The infantry moves north into Losheim [5]: 1 MP for the road connection and 2 MP for crossing out of Zone 5 into Zone 6. It must stop.
Moving west into Bleialf [11] instead, the restricted boundary (the Schnee Eifel) takes its entire movement allowance and it must stop. The armor unit may not cross this boundary at all.
Moving south and then west instead, the infantry uses road connections through Pronsfeld [3] and Lutzkampen [12] into St. Vith [23], 1 MP each.

The armor unit pays 3 MP to enter Losheim [5] and must stop unless the German player spends a fuel asset. With fuel it goes on by road through Bucholz [10] and Bleialf [11] into St. Vith [23], its full 6 MP.
With the Boundary Crossing Pre-authorized asset, the same path to St. Vith [23] costs only 4 MP. Without a fuel asset, though, the armor unit must stop in Bleialf [11].
steps.mp: 4 MP to St. Vith; more than 3 MP needs fuel

steps.cap: Moving south and then west by road through Pronsfeld [3] and Lutzkampen [12], the armor unit reaches St. Vith [23] for 3 MP. No fuel asset is needed.

The Germans have secured Bastogne [47], opening a gap in the Allied line. The 82nd strat-moves from Entry Area H (Givet [96]) to La Roche [62] and the 101st from Entry Area J (La Chapelle [87]) to Champlon [74], through friendly-controlled, uncontested areas.

The 18th VG has advanced into St. Vith [23]; the Allied player spends a Special Action to bring the CCB/9th Arm in from Ligneuville [25]. Defensive fire scores two hits: the 18th VG loses a step, then aborts the attack and becomes disordered.

The 116th Pz, across the river into Weiswampach [22] without a river assault, attacks the 112/28th. Its three hits make the 112/28th retreat and then eliminate it; the excess hit lets the 116th Pz pass a morale check and gain an exploitation marker.
Turn 2, Breakthrough Movement Phase: the German player plans a sequence of breakthrough moves in and through Weiswampach [22].
The 116th Pz, marked with an exploitation marker, moves one area from Weiswampach [22] into Houffalize [36]. The CCR/9th Arm is there, so a round of combat is mandatory.

Pz Lehr, in reserve in Dasburg [13], moves into Marnach [21] for 2 MP and Weiswampach [22] for 1 MP, then spends a fuel asset to go on into Vielsalm [24] for 2 MP. The 106th Inf is there, so a round of combat is mandatory.
The German player spends a Special Action to move the 150th Panzer Brigade forward one area, from Lutzkampen [12] into Weiswampach [22].
In Houffalize [36] the CCR/9th Arm scores one hit and the 116th Pz loses a step; the 116th Pz replies with one hit. The CCR/9th Arm absorbs it by retreating into Noville [48], disordered.
In Vielsalm [24] the 106th Inf misses with three dice and Pz Lehr scores two hits. The 106th Inf retreats into Baraque de Fraiture [35], disordered, and is reduced to two steps.

KG Peiper has pushed on to Werbomont [51], but the 18th VG failed to clear Trois Ponts [34]. Peiper may not trace supply into Stoumont [52] (next to the 1st Infantry in Aywaille [53]), through Manhay [50] (the 168th Engineers' defended roadblock) or into enemy-controlled Trois Ponts, so it is unsupplied.
